content: Asay gade aqisizitayisinnee, mawuter yezitayis moodinttod garkk, haayotithar kiitinttodayisinnee lo77o ooso ubba oothodayis giigintteezita maaqqoday garkk qopisoba.
Ma unttii oollakka iita odinttaamay garkk, saro as maaqqod garkk, ashikkitannee as ubbayis keehizita maaqqod garkk zoroba.
Nuunii tiina boozita, kiitinttoozitta, balintteezita, duma duma asho ufayssisinnee amos ayllitteezita. Nuunii iitatitharannee qinaater kumeezita; nu as ixxizita, asikka nuna ixxizita.
Zini dhale maaqqeez Xooss keehetithannee siiqqay qoncceez wode
nu ootheez geeshsha oosay gishos baazin fa maarotithay gishos nuna ashsheeza. E nuna ashsheezay, nam7antho yelintto meechcharannee Geeshsha Ayyana baggar inggeez oroth yessara.
Ye Ayyana, Xoossii nuna ashshiza Yesuus Kiristtoosa baggar nuul afa gaanthii gogiseeza.
Fa aadho keehetithay baggar nuna xillisii medhina de7o laata ufayassa ekkod garkk yeya ootheeza.
Yha qaalay ammanintteezaya. Xooss ammanizitay lo77o ooso oothodayis giigeezita maaqqod garkk ne yha qaala miinthii odod garkk ta koyiza. Yeyititay as ubbayis lo77onnee maaddizita.
Zini boozitay palamayppe, kochche taybopp, kachchapennee higgepp denddeezayid denddiza cachapp naaginttoba. Yeyi maaddoowa wodhe baa bazi.
Phalqqithi medhdhiza atha pettii toke woy nam7i toke zorii yeypp guye yey garkk athaypp haakkoba.
Yey garkk as zhucannee nagaranchcho; E faal afa pirddeezana eroba.
Taanii balggo ezayid shaaccodayis qoppeez gishos Arxemaasa woy Tikiqoosa neeko kiittiza wode ne taako Niqophiloona ye7odayis minggoba.
Higge eriz Zeenasannee Aphiloosa oge yhanigodar unttis koshshiza baz paccaamaygarkk unttan maaddoba.
Nu asaykka pathoowa as maaqqii attamay garkk paas beeziza baz denggoday garkk lo77o ooso oothodayis miinggii tamaaro.
Taara yez ubbay nena saro giza; ammanor nuna siiqiza asita saro goba. Xooss aadho keehatithay yi ubbayira maaqqo. Amin77ii.
